items.quote: Thermal analysis measurements of the alloy samples (about 15 mg) were investigated in Al2O3 crucibles under a flowing pure N2 atmosphere using differential thermal analysis (DTA, TA Instruments SDT/Q-600) at different heating and cooling rates of 10 and 20 K min-1, respectively.
The microstructure examination and composition analysis of alloy samples (about 1 g) were measured by scanning electron microscopy with energy-dispersive X-ray analysis (SEM/EDS, FEI 450G).

items.label: Mn70Gd30 alloy
items.quote: To achieve compositional homogeneity, the alloys (except for Mn70Gd30 alloy) were annealed in an evacuated quartz tube at 873 K for 336 h and then were quenched in ice water.

items.label: The alloys
items.quote: Mn and Gd (99.99% purity, China New Metal Materials Technology Company, Ltd.) were used as starting materials. The alloys with the mass about 3 g were prepared by arc-melting pure elements under argon atmosphere using a nonconsumable tungsten electrode and were re-melted several times in order to improve their homogeneity.
